info.name: Sheet Music
info.summary: Manage and synchronize sheet music, scores, and chord charts
info.description:
Sheet Music turns your Nextcloud instance into a centralized sheet music library and browser studio for solo musicians, choirs, bands, and orchestras.
### Key Features
- **Comprehensive Score Catalog**: Browse in Card, Table, or Simple List view with inline editing, batch operations, duplicate merging, deep-linkable filters, and rich musical metadata (composers, lyricists, artists, arrangers, books, collections, genres, keys, tempo, time signature, difficulty, and ratings). - **Score Viewer, Annotations & Setlist Performance Mode**: High-performance PDF viewer with single-page, two-page (half-page, 1-page step, 2-page jump), and continuous layouts, freehand/stylus annotations (pressure sensitivity, palm rejection, fingerings, symbols, text), bookmarks, drag-and-drop setlists, touch/keyboard/Bluetooth pedal page turning, next-song preloading, and screen wake lock. - **Offline Setlists & PWA Standalone Mode**: Save setlists for offline playback with Cache Storage and install Sheet Music as a fullscreen Progressive Web App on tablets and desktops. - **In-Browser PDF Tools**: Reorder pages for repeats/Codas, rotate, crop margins for tablet/e-ink screens, split or join PDFs, enhance scans (contrast, grayscale, binarization, deskew), and edit bookmarks without leaving Nextcloud. - **Library & Sub-Library Sharing**: Create filtered sub-libraries by instrument, ensemble, or composer and share full libraries or sub-libraries with Nextcloud users, groups, or via public MobileSheets sync links without duplicating PDFs. - **MobileSheets WebDAV Sync**: Built-in bidirectional synchronization for MobileSheets users (Android, iOS/iPadOS, Windows) via virtual `mobilesheets.db` and `mobilesheets_hashcodes.txt` endpoints served dynamically over Nextcloud WebDAV. - **Library Health & Nextcloud Integration**: Automated file path organization, PDF metadata embedding, integrity & orphan checker, plus Nextcloud file version history and Trash Bin protection.
### Disclaimer
This app is primarily AI-generated and provided as-is without any warranty. There is no guarantee regarding data safety, stability, or freedom from breaking changes. Please back up your sheet music files and Nextcloud database regularly before installing or updating.
info.author: Christoph Wick
